repost.content:
Ever wondered whether your PTP grandmaster is actually telling the truth?
Now you can literally watch it. ⏱️
My side project "ptp-wallclock" grew from a Raspberry Pi painting the time
onto an LED matrix into a proper little PTPv2 client, open source, one
docker run away:
🌐 Web UI with settings and a live nanosecond clock and all grandmaster details
🐳 No LED hardware? Docker mode turns any browser into a glowing
fullscreen PTP clock
🚨 Alerts on grandmaster changes or when an unapproved GM takes over
Not a reference clock, but for machine rooms, classrooms and proving
"yes, PTP really is distributing time here", it's what I always wanted
on the wall. First version demoed in my 39C3 talk "Excuse me, what
precise time is it?" and now used at our simplexity PTP-Trainings

#PTP #IEEE1588 #ST2110 #AES67 #BroadcastEngineering #RaspberryPi
#OpenSource #Timing
